Defense & Aerospace

Trust. Responsibility. Defense.

With passion and a sense of responsibility, we are shaping the defense of tomorrow – technologically strong, rooted in our nation, and based on partnerships among equals.

Follow Us

  • Career
  • Perspectives
  • Industries
  • Defense & Aerospace

As a trusted IT partner to the armed forces and the defense industry, we play a key role in strengthening the defense capabilities of Germany and its allies through innovative digital solutions. In our Defense & Aerospace business unit, we combine many years of leadership and operational experience with in-depth industry expertise – knowledge that flows directly into our projects and forms the basis for tailored, future-proof solutions. 

What sets us apart is a culture of collaboration rooted in genuine camaraderie and mutual trust. We embrace flat hierarchies and consistently adhere to the principle of “management by delegation”: We give you the freedom to take ownership and act with an entrepreneurial spirit so you can apply your expertise where it makes the biggest difference. Join a team that takes responsibility and works together to shape the safety of tomorrow.

Our Key Areas of Focus

  • NATO Architecture Framework (NAF3, NAF4, NAFv4@ADMBw)
  • Bundeswehr Architecture Data Model (ADMBw)
  • ARIS4BWI 
  • API-first approaches, container and orchestration concepts 
  • C2 (Command & Control) systems and multi-domain operations 
  • SitaWare (system integration, add-on development, C2 plugins) 
  • Interoperable and modular software architectures 

  • BSI Basic Protection and DEUmilSAA Requirements
  • Security Modeling Tools: SAVe and verinice
  • Zero-Trust Architectures and In-Depth System Hardening
  • SOC/SIEM (Security Operations Center / Security Information and Event Management) 
  • Security-by-Design and Incident Response Processes 
  • Vulnerability Management and Penetration Testing 

  • Strict DevOps principles (ranging from tactical tools to backend services)
  • Software Development as a Service (SDaaS) for military needs
  • Classified (Verschlusssachen)-compliant development platforms & fully managed services
  • Air-gapped environments (isolated networks without cloud connectivity)
  • Software-Defined Defense Platforms
  • Industry-Specific msg Products: msg.Moewe, msg.Strike, msg.Vysthos 

  • Air-Gapped GenAI Features (Generative AI without Internet/Cloud Connectivity)
  • MLOps Frameworks (Data Platforms, Pipelines, Governance) in a Secure Environment
  • Agentic AI and Cognitive Services
  • Automated Analysis, Reporting, and Tactical Decision Support 

  • Traditional and Agile Technical Project Management
  • Military and International Standards (e.g., AQAP, MilStd)
  • Make-or-Buy Analyses and In-Depth Feasibility Studies
  • Hardware and Software Systems Development (from concept studies and prototyping to production readiness/qualification)

Continuing Education in Defense & Aerospace

The Defense & Aerospace business unit is a dynamic and rapidly growing industry that offers you a wide range of career opportunities. To ensure you're as well-prepared as possible for your responsibilities, we provide you with ongoing professional development.

Various professional development programs are available to support you – programs that you can access exclusively through Defense & Aerospace in collaboration with the Public Sector division. While “Grow Your Talent” takes a methodically grounded approach focused on personal development and professional expertise, the “Next Level” training programs allow you to delve deeper into the respective disciplines and roles.
